correctness.rationale: For each integer k>=2 the exact conserved integrals C_+=y+psi_+(x), C_-=-y+psi_-(x) and strict monotonicity of each half-axis potential give one finite transverse crossing per half-plane arc. A negative-axis radius r maps to positive radius r^2 and back to negative radius r^4. The only positive periodic radius is 1; the closed oval has period 4 and transverse multiplier (r^4)' at 1 = 4. Radii <1 have finite total remaining time bounded by the doubly-exponential flight sum, with the stipulated absorbing convention at zero; radii >1 escape to spatial infinity with no finite-time blow-up since |xdot|=1. Integrating the two boundary graph pairs gives area 4-2/(2k+1)-2/(4k+1). Boundary and singular-origin continuation are part of the hypotheses.
